name: A blacksmith with his eqipment and a sleeping dog
summary: The blacksmith attends to his small smoking furnace set up on a stand, perhaps encouraging the flames by blowing through a pipe; beside him are a wooden pail with rope attached, an anvil, cylindrical bellows beside the furnace, a bench and a sleeping dog.
